question: To what extent can the fruit of Kāśī ever be expressed?
premises: The fruit of Kāśī is the subject.
Any telling would be only somewhat.
Capability to tell is only hypothetical.
inference: Therefore one might at most be able to tell only a little of Kāśī's fruit.
plain_english: Then, O goddess, one might be able to tell only somewhat of the fruit of Kāśī.
